sql: select 'create_listener_attempts' as k, count(*)::text as a from evo_heartbeats where actions_json::text ilike '%create_listener%' union all select 'remove_listener_attempts', count(*)::text from evo_heartbeats where actions_json::text ilike '%remove_listener%' union all select 'audit_listener_kind', count(*)::text from evo_audit_events where kind ilike '%listener%'
